articles.title: Claude arrive dans Google Docs, Sheets et Slides
articles.text:
Bonne nouvelle pour les utilisateurs de Claude : une toute nouvelle extension permet d’utiliser toute la puissance de cette IA au sein de Google Docs, Sheets et Slides.
Décidément, Anthropic est bien occupé ces dernières semaines : le créateur de l’intelligence artificielle Claude, qui prépare toujours son entrée en Bourse, ne cesse de monter en puissance depuis le lancement de son modèle Fable 5 en juin dernier. Il a depuis déployé deux autres moutures, Opus 5.5 et Sonnet 5.5, et vient de frapper un grand coup en débarquant au sein des documents Google. On fait le point.
Claude dévoile une extension pour Google Docs, Sheets et Slides
Dans un récent article de blog, Anthropic a dévoilé une toute nouvelle extension, nommée Claude for Google Workspace™. L’outil, intégré dans la suite bureautique de Google, peut notamment « lire le document, la feuille de calcul ou la présentation que vous avez ouvert, identifier le texte, les cellules ou les diapositives que vous avez sélectionnés, et apporter des modifications directement dans le fichier. »
Pour installer Claude for Google Workspace™, il suffit d’ouvrir un document (Docs, par exemple), de cliquer sur le bouton « Extensions » visible dans le menu puis sur « Modules complémentaires » > « Télécharger des modules complémentaires » et de taper « Claude » dans la barre de recherche qui apparaît à l’écran. Il ne vous restera plus qu’à cliquer sur le bouton « Installer » et à retrouver, par la suite, l’outil dans votre liste d’extensions.
Comment fonctionne Claude for Google Workspace™ ?
Une fois le module activé, un panneau latéral sera disponible sur la droite de votre écran, à côté du document sur lequel vous travaillez. Vous pourrez, par exemple, sélectionner du texte ou une cellule et corriger des phrases, demander la rédaction de formules, créer des diapositives et bien plus encore. La liste complète des options est disponible dans l'annonce .
Pour éviter les mauvaises surprises, un mode « Demander avant de modifier » est activé par défaut. Les plus téméraires pourront s’en passer en basculant vers le mode « Tout accepter ». Toutefois, on vous conseille, par prudence, de vous en tenir au premier réglage.
- Excellente compréhension des consignes complexes
- Très bon niveau en rédaction
- Analyse de longs documents efficace
Anthropic précise également que « lorsque vous êtes connecté à votre compte Claude, la barre latérale affiche les mêmes modèles, connecteurs et compétences que ceux que vous utilisez dans Claude. » Les professionnels seront ravis de savoir que les API de conformité, les clés de chiffrement gérées par le client (CMEK) et l’exportation d’audit OpenTelemetry sont bien pris en charge par l’extension.
Pour le moment, ce nouvel outil est disponible en bêta publique et réservé uniquement aux abonnés payants. Il devrait concurrencer Gemini qui est, rappelons-le, intégré nativement à Workspace. Reste à voir si Claude for Google Workspace™ parviendra à détrôner l’IA de Google au sein de sa propre suite bureautique.

articles.title: Recur Club launches festive season Rs 500 crore fund for D2C brands
articles.text:
Festive season bonanza: Recur Club launches Rs 500 Cr fund for D2C brands
The fund aims to address the two key capital challenges of D2C brands during the festive season: inventory financing and capacity expansion.
Recur Club, a debt platform for startups and SMEs, has announced a Rs 500 crore fund to facilitate growth capital for D2C brands in the current financial year.
Based on the current average ticket size of approximately Rs 3 crore, the fund is expected to support 150-170 D2C brands, depending on their individual financing requirements, Recur Club said in a statement.
Recur Club noted that D2C brands typically require additional capital for the forthcoming festive season to build inventory and expand their presence. The demand for growth capital during the festive season typically rises by around 35%, the firm said.
According to Recur Club, the two key capital challenges faced by D2C brands are inventory financing and capacity expansion. The debt platform claims that through inventory financing, it enables brands to have inventory procured on their behalf, sell it through their existing channels, and repay the financing in installments without adding debt to their balance sheets.
For store and capacity expansion, Recur Club will help acquire equipment and fit-outs for new stores, with brands paying a monthly rental until the financing is repaid, turning capex into opex.
Eklavya Gupta, Co-founder, Recur Club, said, "The festive season can make or break a D2C brand's year, and this year the pressure is higher. Packaging costs have risen by around 21% amid geopolitical tensions in the Gulf region. At the same time, quick commerce is taking a larger share of D2C sales, so brands need to stock more inventory, across more channels, earlier than ever. Our D2C fund is designed to address this timing gap and structure the repayments around your business."
In the current financial year, Recur Club has facilitated approximately Rs 275 crore for over 100 D2C brands, taking the cumulative capital for the D2C sector to Rs 1,200 crore.

articles.title: Kore.ai launches Autoloop to keep tuning enterprise AI agents after they go live - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Kore.ai launches Autoloop to keep tuning enterprise AI agents after they go live
Enterprise artificial intelligence platform company Kore.ai Inc. today launched Autoloop, an optimization engine for the AI agents that customers build on its Kore.ai Agent Platform.
Businesses set the targets, and Autoloop keeps adjusting the agents to hit them automatically, including after they’re deployed.
Autoloop goes after the way most enterprises maintain agents today, fixing failures by hand one at a time. Patching one problem often opens up another, according to Kore.ai. In the company’s “2026 Kore.ai Agent Productivity Index,” 79% of enterprises reported reversing an action taken by an AI agent. A failure their teams could not trace had hit 70% of them.
Customers set up Autoloop by giving it goals covering measures such as task completion, adherence to business rules and cost, and the engine optimizes for all of them at once. Accuracy is one of the goals as well, judged on whether answers are backed by the enterprise’s own data. Every proposed change is scored against the full set, so lower token spending cannot quietly come at the cost of safety or the agent’s ability to finish the job.
Autoloop writes the first version of each agent, tests included, from the operating procedures a company already has, then keeps iterating until every goal is met. Real interactions start fresh rounds of optimization once the agent is in production.
Spotting where a goal slipped falls to Kore.ai’s StateTrace evaluation layer. Agents are judged against the full record of what they did in production, down to each handoff, tool call and state change across a network of agents. A five-layer validation architecture makes most of the checks deterministic. The company says that keeps round-the-clock optimization affordable at enterprise scale.
Kore.ai’s Agent Blueprint Language handles the fix. Introduced earlier this year, the language compiles routing, business rules and guardrails into an executable state machine, so each step in a trace maps back to a specific part of the blueprint. Autoloop can then rewrite only the piece responsible for a miss.
“You can’t optimize what you can’t see, or fix precisely what you can’t express precisely,” said Prasanna Arikala, Kore.ai’s chief technology officer and chief product officer. He credited the two technologies with making automatic optimization practical.
The approach behind Autoloop also shapes Kore.ai’s own software development, where AI agents write code. About 6,500 commits a month to the company’s 2.6 million-line production codebase now come from those agents, which work under 68 always-on guardrails. Founder and Chief Executive Raj Koneru said the companies that manage to scale AI “will be the ones using AI to build, govern and optimize AI.”
Autoloop is available now to all customers on the Kore.ai Agent Platform’s Artemis edition, which launched in May. Kore.ai counts more than 500 Global 2000 organizations as customers.

articles.title: Google libera detector de IA para qualquer pessoa • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Google libera detector de IA para qualquer pessoa
SynthID Detector verifica se arquivos contêm marcas d'água de IA. A novidade analisa imagens, vídeos e áudios.
O Google acaba de liberar mais um recurso de inteligência artificial. Desta vez, não é algo para produzir conteúdo, mas para detectá-lo: a companhia anunciou o SynthID Detector para permitir que qualquer pessoa analise uma imagem, um vídeo ou um áudio para descobrir se esse arquivo foi gerado por IA.
Esta não é uma ferramenta exatamente nova. O próprio Google explica que o SynthID Detector foi introduzido no ano passado, em fase de prévia, “para ajudar profissionais de mídia a verificar conteúdo gerado por IA”.
Agora, depois de ter sido aperfeiçoado, o SynthID Detector está sendo liberado para qualquer pessoa, em escala global. O seu uso é fácil: acesse o site do serviço, toque ou clique no campo principal e faça upload de um arquivo de mídia para ser analisado.
Em seguida, a ferramenta informará se aquele conteúdo foi gerado ou editado com inteligência artificial. Ou quase isso (você já vai entender).
Podemos imaginar que o SynthID Detector simplesmente analisa um arquivo para encontrar características que sugerem que aquela mídia tem traços de IA. Mas não é bem assim: o que a ferramenta faz, na verdade, é verificar se o arquivo tem uma marca d’água digital inserida por um mecanismo de IA compatível.
O próprio Google ressalta, na área de ajuda da ferramenta, que o SynthID Detector não funciona como um “detector geral de IA”, que analisa artefatos e padrões no conteúdo para estimar a probabilidade de ele ter sido gerado por IA.
Por padrão, a ferramenta checa se arquivos de mídia receberam uma marca d’água invisível por meio da tecnologia SynthID. Mas vai além: o SynthID Detector também pode identificar o conteúdo marcado por tecnologias similares de outras empresas, como OpenAI, Nvidia, Kakao e, em breve, Apple.
Neste ponto, vale fazer uma distinção para evitar confusões: o SynthID por si só é uma tecnologia do Google DeepMind que marca conteúdos gerados ou editados com IA; o SynthID Detector é uma ferramenta complementar que tem o propósito de ajudar o usuário a identificar esses conteúdos.
Observe que, apesar de ter sido liberado em escala global, o SynthID Detector está disponível somente em inglês neste momento. A ferramenta é gratuita, mas requer uma Conta Google para ser usada.

Intel Prepares Core 2000HX Series for Laptops Based on "Raptor Lake Next"
Intel is reportedly developing laptop chips based on its rumored "Raptor Lake Next" CPU core architecture, which will be branded as the Core 2000HX series. As readers may recall, Intel is already planning "Raptor Lake Next" chips as an update to its Socket LGA-1700 desktop processors. These chips are necessary to provide options for PC buyers who are stuck with the decade-old DDR4 memory standard due to the DDR5 memory pricing crisis, given that the current Core Ultra "Arrow Lake" processors lack DDR4 backward compatibility.
For mobile "Raptor Lake Next" chips, we can expect Intel to bring a core configuration of up to 8 P-Cores and 16 E-Cores, for a total of 24 cores, similar to the regular "Raptor Lake" and "Raptor Lake Refresh" chips. Since "Nova Lake-HX" laptop chips are expected to carry the Core Ultra 4000HX naming scheme, Intel will drop "Ultra" and downgrade the series naming to Core 2000HX to differentiate the new Intel 18A chips from the older Intel 7 "Raptor Lake" dies that will be part of the "Raptor Lake Next" designs. We can expect slight adjustments, as seen with the "Raptor Lake Refresh," that improve D2D latency and include some minor tweaks.Originally, Intel released the first "Raptor Lake" design for mobile in 2023 with the 13th Generation Core i9-13980HX, followed by a refresh in 2024 with the 14th Generation Core i9-14900HX. In recent years, we have seen flagship "Raptor Lake Refresh" SKUs like the Core 7 150U and Core 9 270H released in 2024, and again this year, we are expecting to see something in the form of Core 9 2xxxHX. Since "Arrow Lake-HX" uses the Core Ultra 200HX branding, this would avoid confusion with the previous models.

articles.title: Kamrui Essenx E2 vs Bosgame E5 11 Pro: The new mini PC to beat
articles.text:
Kamrui Essenx E2 vs Bosgame E5 11 Pro: Newcomer trounces Amazon’s best selling Windows PC for Prime Day in the $300 category
Two contenders, one winner
Ladies and gentlemen, on my right, costing $322.98 and most popular new Windows PC at Amazon is the Kamrui Essenx E2.
Its challenger is the Bosgame E5 11 Pro, a lightweight PC that punches above its weight and costs only $263.49.
Let’s see who is the better (best?). Remember that you need to be a Prime member in order to benefit from these prices. You can sign up for a free 30-day trial here.
AMD Ryzen 5300U | 16GB DDR4 | 512GB
The newcomer upstart set to take the crown from Amazon's best-selling $300 Windows PC.
AMD Ryzen 5 3500U | 16GB DDR4 | 256GB SSD
This Windows mini PC from Kamrui is a popular pick in the $300-ish budget category.
Performance
On paper, the Bosgame bosses the Kamrui around (excuse the pun). The Ryzen 5 3500U is no match for the Ryzen 3 5300U. Both have four cores but the latter uses a newer architecture and achieves better performance both in single thread (+17%) and multi thread (+26%).
The 5300U also runs cooler despite having a faster clock speed, which should translate into a quieter work environment. Same conclusion for the integrated Radeon video subsystem: the GPU used by the 5300U (RX Vega 6) is faster than the RX Vega 8 on the 3500U. So despite the Ryzen 3 moniker, the 5300U inside the Bosgame is a comfortable winner here.
Storage and memory
Both offer 16GB of RAM, one can assume two 8GB DDR4 memory modules for improved performance. The 5300U uses DDR4-3200 as opposed to DDR4-2666 for the 3500U, a marginal improvement in transfer rates that should help with performance.
On the storage side, Bosgame has twice the capacity (512GB vs 256GB) compared to its rival. Both use PCIe 3.0 which is fast enough for casual computing (whatever that means these days).
Both mini PCs also have an additional SSD slot. A legacy SATA one for the Kamrui and a PCIe one for the other contender. The E5 11 Pro emerges as victorious once again.
Ports and connectivity
Kamrui’s mini PC uses an older platform so I am not surprised that it can only handle two 4K monitors. It doesn’t have any Type-C connector as well and two of its USB ports use obsolete USB 2.0 tech. As for connectivity, you’ve got a Gigabit LAN port and an unknown variety of wireless connection which I assume is WiFi-5 as a worst case scenario.
The E5 11 Pro fares much better; it has one extra Type-C connector that allows it to support three 4K monitors, two 2.5Gb LAN connectors. That said, you still get WiFi-5 and those pesky USB 2.0 ports. There could only ever be one winner and that’s the Bosgame.
Anything else?
Both come with old school barrel chargers (not ideal) and have VESA ports. Both run on Windows although Bosgame uses Windows 11 Pro and is Linux/Ubuntu compatible as well, great for dual booting.
And the winner is?
No photo finish on that one. There’s no reason why anyone should buy the Kamrui Essenx E2 over the E5 11 Pro. The latter is not only a genuinely far superior product, it is also way cheaper, by almost 20% (nearly $60).

articles.title: Modelos virtuales, robots en pasarelas de Milán y predicción de tendencias: así la IA conquista la moda
articles.text:
La inteligencia artificial está presente en diversos ámbitos, incluida la moda. Ya existen modelos generadas con esta tecnología que trabajan con grandes casas de moda de Europa, además de plataformas que ayudan a monitorear tendencias.
De cara a los usuarios, también hay espacios en los que esta tecnología y la moda se encuentra: existen plataformas y herramientas en ChatGPT o Google Fotos que permiten construir atuendos con avatares recreados a partir de la persona.
La convergencia entre la inteligencia artificial y la moda también llegó a los eventos del sector. Fashion AI Expo se inauguró en París en marzo de 2026. Organizada por Olga Gasnier y en coincidencia con la Semana de la Moda de París, reunió a diseñadores, empresas tecnológicas y ejecutivos del sector del lujo.
Un mes después, Tokio lanzó su propia semana de la moda centrada en la IA, basada en un concurso de diseño generativo organizado por OpenFashion.
En septiembre de 2026, Vogue realizó una pasarela en la que participaron robots humanoides de Unitree. Si bien las celebridades que fueron asistentes como Jennifer Lopez, Anna Wintour y Donatella Versace aplaudieron, en redes sociales se criticó la participación de dispositivos impulsados por IA en lugares como estos.
En la quinta edición de Vogue World, los robots caminaron sin ropa, mientras los diseños de Valentino, Versace, Dior y Armani fueron utilizados por los modelos.
“Esto es horrible, ¿quién pensó que esto era una buena idea?”, escribió una usuaria. Otra comentó: “Literalmente, ¿qué están aplaudiendo?”. Entre los mensajes también apareció una crítica directa a la decisión de incluirlos: “Solo porque puedes, no significa que debas hacerlo”.
Otros usuarios fueron todavía más contundentes. “Nadie quiere esto. Nadie pidió esto. Saca robots del arte inmediatamente”, señaló una internauta.
Cómo son las modelos generadas por IA
Noonoouri, Shudu e Imma son tres modelos generas por inteligencia artificial. Lanzada en 2018 por el artista alemán Joerg Zuber, Noonoouri participó en campañas de Dior, Versace y Marc Jacobs.
Su apariencia, inspirada en una muñeca de proporciones estilizadas, se aleja deliberadamente de la representación humana.
En Instagram, donde suma 454 mil seguidores, publica contenidos de moda, videos musicales y producciones digitales.
Shudu fue creada por el fotógrafo Cameron-James Wilson y suele ser presentada como la primera supermodelo digital de la industria.
Sus retratos y campañas reproducen los códigos de la fotografía editorial, en contraste con el diseño más fantástico de Noonoouri. Su cuenta de Instagram tiene 235 mil seguidores.
Creada por Aww Inc., Imma es una modelo virtual japonesa identificada por su cabello rosa. Fue portada de Vogue Japón y participó en campañas para Dior y Valentino.
Sus publicaciones la sitúan en viajes, eventos, comercios y espacios urbanos, en sintonía con la estética callejera de Tokio. En Instagram, reúne más de 377 mil seguidores.
Plataforma con IA para monitorear tendencias de moda
La plataforma Heuritech analiza millones de imágenes publicadas en redes sociales para detectar qué prendas usa la gente y cómo cambian los colores, los estampados y las siluetas.
Fundada en París en 2013 por dos doctores en aprendizaje automático, la plataforma procesa esos datos para anticipar movimientos dentro de la moda.
Entre las marcas que utilizan la herramienta figuran Louis Vuitton y Dior.
Heuritech sostiene que puede predecir tendencias con una precisión cercana al 90% y hasta con dos años de anticipación, a partir del seguimiento de atributos específicos, como el crecimiento de un tipo de punto o la aparición recurrente de un patrón de cuadros de una temporada a otra.
Cómo fue el Fashion AI Expo en París
Fashion AI Expo debutó en París con un desfile de Pierre Cardin y una agenda de encuentros entre diseñadores, startups de inteligencia artificial y ejecutivos vinculados al sector del lujo. La primera edición reunió participantes de ciudades como París, Zúrich, Dubái, Barcelona, Berlín, Nueva York y Viena.
Un mes después, Tokio organizó su propia Semana de la Moda de IA. Su concurso de diseño generativo, bajo el lema “Utilidad del Futuro”, propuso aplicar estas herramientas a ropa de trabajo y prendas preparadas para situaciones de desastre, en lugar de los formatos habituales de ropa de noche y desfiles.
En junio de 2026, el London College of Fashion celebró su tercer Simposio Internacional sobre IA en la Moda, donde se discutió la capacidad de los sistemas generativos para producir diseños derivados de obras protegidas por derechos de autor.
Las jornadas también abordaron el riesgo de que los datos con los que se entrenan estos modelos reproduzcan estándares restringidos de belleza y tipo de cuerpo.
Las conversaciones sobre derechos de autor y autoría no ofrecieron una respuesta definitiva: ninguna de las herramientas de diseño con IA utilizadas en el mercado ha resuelto de forma vinculante quién posee los derechos sobre una creación generada con estos sistemas.

articles.title: I compared this year's top SSD, RAM and GPU deals on Amazon Prime Day to the bargains around a year ago, and it's grim reading — with a few exceptions
articles.text:
The best Amazon Prime Day SSD, RAM, and GPU deals are more sad than exciting — the prices compared to last year show how bad things have got, but there is some GPU goodness here
Hard times for key PC components, although some graphics card discounts are worthy of consideration
Amazon Prime Day is in full swing and while there are plenty of tempting deals to be had for all sorts of tech in general, the computing component side of the big sale is a depressingly barren place.
• Browse the full Amazon Prime Day sale
When it comes to the core components of a PC which have been hit hardest by the memory crisis – RAM sticks, SSDs, and GPUs – the deals which Amazon is offering may look like sizeable discounts on the face of it, but they aren't when you consider the pricing which these products were available at last year.
A case in point: the Samsung 9100 PRO 2TB SSD is currently half price at $335 (down from $680) at Amazon US, but a year ago, it was $165 in the Prime Day sale. So, in fact, this year you are paying twice as much as in 2025, which doesn't feel great.
That said, in the overall SSD landscape, this is now a decent price, which just shows how bad the RAM crisis has made everything.
Of course, the pricing of RAM itself is particularly painful. For example, there's a 64GB RAM kit (2 x 32GB modules) from Crucial on sale with 7% off at Amazon UK, but it's £690 after that discount. A year ago, that same kit was £170. Ouch.
A more commonplace 32GB kit (2 x 16GB) from Crucial is now on offer at Amazon UK with a 22% discount, bringing it down to £400 – while a year ago it was £108.
Let that sink in for a moment: it's an effective quadrupling of the prices in both these RAM examples.
As for GPUs, the Asus Prime RX 9070 XT Gaming graphics card has a 23% discount on Amazon US, reducing it to $829. Yet in the Prime Day sale a year ago, this was at $690 (and it actually dropped to $649 for the holiday season on Amazon, so it's now close to 30% pricier than that when it's on sale).
What a difference a year makes, and sadly a very negative difference, but while it's undeniably bleak out there, thankfully there are a few deals worth considering for Prime Day components in the US and UK.
I'll list them below, and they include what might be the best deals you'll get on a mid-range and a higher-end GPU for possibly quite a long time (depending on how the RAM crisis continues to affect video memory, and the latest hints aren't good).
Today's best Prime Day PC component deals in the US
This Sandisk drive is 15% off in the US and gives you a somewhat palatable deal for 1TB of storage space, bearing in mind that a few months ago, it was actually a hundred bucks dearer than this sale price. It's a PCIe Gen 4.0 SSD and offers sequential reads of up to 7,250MB/s and writes of 6,900MB/s.
If you need system memory, frankly there really aren't any good deals on RAM. If you're okay with having DDR4 RAM, though, this 16% discount on a Corsair Vengeance 32GB RAM kit in the US is about as good as it gets right now – but that's not very good sadly (and still hugely inflated on a year ago, but the worry is, things may get worse still).
The GRE is not a particularly well-liked flavor of the RX 9070, mainly because gamers feel that it doesn't offer good value compared to the vanilla 9070 (and it's considerably behind the 9070 XT in performance). However, at this price with a 33% discount in the US – pushing it under the MSRP – it stacks up well with these sibling Radeon GPUs, and currently it represents about as good a mid-range graphics card bargain as you'll get.

KTC 27-inch 210Hz gaming and 15.6-inch portable monitors discounted up to 24 percent at Newegg — 210 Hz 1440p gaming and portable displays as low as $57
Newegg is ringing in some hefty discounts on KTC gaming and portable monitors.
Currently, Newegg is offering solid discounts on four KTC monitors, ranging from a 15.6-inch portable monitor to a 27-inch 200 Hz QHD gaming monitor, with prices starting as low as $56.99 after the coupon.
KTC might not be a name that's familiar to you in the monitor space, but it's one that we here at Tom's Hardware have increasingly had hands-on time with in recent years. While KTC’s monitors are sometimes light on features (like internal speakers or USB ports), they often offer excellent performance and extreme value for enthusiasts.
The KTC H24T7 is a 24-inch 1440p gaming monitor with a native 180 Hz refresh rate and FreeSync/G-Sync support.
The smallest gaming monitor available on sale is the KTC H24T7. The monitor typically retails for $189.99, but is on sale for $149.99. The discount code "FTTF8356" knocks another $5 off the price, bringing it to $144.99. This 24-inch monitor has a 2560 x 1440 resolution and a Fast IPS panel. According to KTC, it has a native refresh rate of 180 Hz, although you can overclock it to 185 Hz within the OSD. Other specs worth mentioning include a 1 ms response time, 400 nits typical brightness, 1,000:1 contrast ratio, and AMD FreeSync/Nvidia G-Sync compatibility.
As for ports, you’ll find two HDMI 2.0 ports, one DisplayPort 1.4 port, and a 3.5 mm audio jack.
The KTC H27T22C-3 features a 27-inch 1440p Fast IPS panel that can refresh at up to 210 Hz with overclocking.
If you’re looking for a smidge more diagonal screen real estate (without increasing resolution), there's the H27T6 and H27T22C-3. Both monitors offer similar specs, including a 27-inch Fast IPS panel, 1440p resolution, 1ms response time, 200 Hz native refresh rate (210 MHz with overclocking), 1,000:1 contrast ratio, and 450 nits typical brightness.
Both monitors also include two internal speakers, two HDMI 2.0 ports, two DisplayPort 1.4 ports, and a 3.5 mm audio jack. The primary difference between the two is that the H27T6's display can pivot 90 degrees, allowing it to operate in landscape or portrait orientation. It also features a white housing for its back panel instead of black.
The H27T6 is priced at $164.99 after a $5 off coupon (FTTF8357) at Newegg, while the H27T22C-3 can be had for $174.99 after coupon (FTTF8355).
The H27T6 is another 27-inch 1440p 210 Hz gaming monitor from KTC, but this one ups the ante with a rotating display that can be used in a landscape or portrait orientation.
Finally, we switch gears to the H15F9 15.6-inch 1080p portable monitor. Over the past several years, portable monitors have become increasingly cheaper, making them an affordable option to add a second screen for boosting productivity while traveling. In the case of the H15F9, it weighs just 1.4 pounds, making it less of a burden when squeezing it into your laptop bag. It also has one of my must-have features for a portable monitor: a built-in kickstand. The kickstand allows you to adjust the tilt of the panel, and I much prefer it to detachable magnetic kickstands or origami case+stand setups that you see with other portable monitors.
The KTC H15F9 is a 15.6-inch portable monitor with a 1080p resolution and a built-in kickstand.
On the connectivity front, you'll find two USB-C ports (DisplayPort Alt Mode supported) and a mini HDMI port to support a wide range of devices (including smartphones, tablets, and consoles like the Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, or Xbox Series X).
The H15F9 normally retails for $69.99, but right now it is priced at $56.99 after a $3 off coupon (FTTF8359).

articles.title: TechSparks 2026: From AI and defence to edtech and SaaS, more builders join the New Tech Order
articles.text:
TechSparks 2026: From AI and defence to edtech and SaaS, more builders join the New Tech Order
Founders, technology leaders, and investors working across AI, social media, fintech, SaaS, education, defence, and deeptech join the TechSparks 2026 speaker lineup.
AI is changing how social platforms understand users, data is becoming critical infrastructure, defence startups are building locally, and businesses are rethinking everything from customer engagement to the workplace.
Behind these shifts are founders and technology leaders building products, infrastructure and companies, and investors deciding which emerging technologies to back.
At TechSparks 2026, YourStory's flagship startup and technology summit, founders, technology leaders, and investors will discuss these changes and what they mean for India’s technology ecosystem, under the theme ‘The New Tech Order’.
The three-day summit will take place in Bengaluru from October 13-15. Karnataka ministers Priyank Kharge, Minister for Home, IT, BT & E-Governance, and Krishna Byre Gowda, Minister for Greater Bengaluru Development, will be part of the event, alongside Pratyaya Amrit, Chief Secretary, Government of Bihar.
Conversations will cover AI, deeptech, digital infrastructure, consumer technology, education, defence, fintech and the future of work.
Here are some of the speakers joining TechSparks 2026:
Dale Vaz
Dale Vaz is Co-founder and CEO of Sahi, a trading platform built for active retail traders. Before becoming an entrepreneur, Vaz was CTO at Swiggy and spent more than a decade at Amazon India, where he led engineering teams. At Sahi, he draws on his experience as both a technologist and long-time trader to build tools for retail market participants.
Nitin Jain
Nitin Jain is Chief Technology Officer at ShareChat and Moj, where he leads technology across the two social platforms. His work spans AI, large-scale data systems, and the technology behind personalised content and recommendations for users across India's languages and regions. Before joining ShareChat, Jain held technology leadership roles at TikTok, Gojek and Tokopedia.
Srividhya Srinivasan
Srividhya Srinivasan is Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer of Amagi, a cloud-native SaaS company serving the media and entertainment industry. She has been at Amagi since its early days and has worked on technology that lets broadcasters and media companies manage and distribute live, linear and on-demand content through the cloud.
Rajeev Rastogi
Rajeev Rastogi is Vice President, Machine Learning at Amazon, where he leads teams working on machine-learning applications across search, advertising, catalogue quality, payments, and forecasting. An ACM Fellow and Bell Labs Fellow, Rastogi has previously served as Vice President of Yahoo Labs and was the founding director of the Bell Labs Research Center in Bengaluru.
Anand Jain
Anand Jain is Co-founder and Chief Marketing Officer of CleverTap, a customer engagement platform used by digital businesses. A technologist and entrepreneur with more than three decades of experience, Jain was previously Chief Product Officer and Chief Strategy Officer at CleverTap. He also co-founded restaurant discovery platform Burrp and has held technology leadership roles at Network18 and Infomedia18.
Sushma Boppana
Sushma Boppana is CEO and Director of Sri Chaitanya Educational Institutions. Her work has focused on expanding access to education and building learning models that combine academic preparation with technology. She is also associated with Infinity Learn, Sri Chaitanya’s edtech platform, which uses digital and personalised learning to reach students beyond the classroom.
Arvind Pani
Arvind Pani is Founder of CoreMantle, which is building data infrastructure for AI across underserved languages, dialects, and contexts. Pani previously co-founded Reverie Language Technologies, which worked on Indian-language technology and was acquired by Reliance Industries. At CoreMantle, he is now focused on building the datasets AI models need to understand a wider range of languages and users.
Manish Khedia
Manish Khedia is Regional Managing Director at The Executive Centre, a premium flexible workspace provider. He has spent more than a decade with the company, helping grow its operations across Indian cities and other markets. His work has followed the changing workplace as enterprises rethink flexibility, collaboration, technology and employee experience.
Priyanka Singhal
Priyanka Singhal is Founder of Ammunic Systems, a defence technology company developing munitions and electronic fuzes in India. The company began in 2019, after Singhal’s exposure to defence technology during an internship at the Defence Research and Development Organisation. Her work is part of India's growing effort to develop defence technology and manufacturing capabilities at home.
Vishesh Rajaram
Vishesh Rajaram is Managing Partner at Speciale Invest, an early-stage venture capital firm focused on deeptech. He co-founded the firm in 2017 and has backed companies working across spacetech, semiconductors, robotics, advanced manufacturing, and climate technology. At TechSparks, he will bring an investor’s view on funding and building science- and IP-led companies from India.
Also joining the TechSparks 2026 lineup are Sridhar Vembu, Chief Scientist and Co-founder, Zoho Corp; Ambarish Kenghe, Group CEO, Angel One; Nicolas Sauvage, Founder and President, TDK Ventures; Auksė Žirgulė, VP of Product, Hostinger; Prakash Jaiswal, Managing Director and India Head, SME Banking, DBS Bank; Navin Mistry, Strategic Partner, Stelcore Commerce; Srinivas Chamarthy, Senior Vice President of Engineering, Site Lead, and Country Head, Diligent India; and Naren Kachroo, Head Artificial Intelligence, GTM India, Google Cloud.
The speakers represent different parts of India’s technology ecosystem, from building AI and the data behind it to investing in deeptech and applying technology across education, defence, finance, media, and the workplace.
Join the conversations at TechSparks 2026, taking place from October 13-15 in Bengaluru.
A Special Shoutout to Our Gifting Partners
A big thank you to our gifting partners, Plum, Sleepy Owl, Sweet Karam Coffee, Soulflower, Rawbare, Go Desi, Must Be Nuts, Gladful, Regal Unlimited, BRÜK, Qubo, Vahdam, The Startup Zone and Quest, for being a part of this journey and helping us make the TechSparks experience more special. We're grateful that you are a part of the TechSparks community.
Edited by Teja Lele

articles.title: HBO Max : notre top 10 des meilleurs films à voir en streaming en octobre 2026
articles.text:
HBO Max : notre top 10 des meilleurs films à voir en streaming en octobre 2026
En quête d'un film de qualité sur HBO Max pour vous détendre dans votre canapé ? Les Numériques vous a concocté sa sélection "maison" des meilleurs longs-métrages à voir en octobre 2026 sur la plateforme de streaming de Warner Bros. Discovery.
Si elle n'atteint pas la popularité de Netflix ou Prime Video, la plateforme de streaming HBO Max a su rentrer dans les habitudes des français grâce à des titres de qualité, et un catalogue de plus de 760 films à proposer.
Un peu perdu dans cette offre pléthorique ? Pas de panique, Les Numériques a fait le tri pour vous et vous propose (comme tous les mois) sa sélection des films incontournables à voir au mois d'octobre sur le service de streaming.
Quels sont les meilleurs films à voir sur HBO Max en octobre 2026 ?
Destination finale : Bloodlines
Hantée par un cauchemar terrifiant qui revient sans cesse, Stefanie, étudiante à l’université, rentre chez elle pour retrouver la trace de la seule personne susceptible d’enrayer ce cycle infernal et de sauver ses proches du sort funeste qui les attend…
Véritable carton au box-office l'année dernière, Destination finale : Bloodlines a aussi et surtout une belle surprise en terme de qualité. Le film revitalise son concept à la fois gore et ludique en le connectant à une grande histoire de malédiction intergénérationnelle. Les différentes morts sont toujours aussi inventives, drôles et jouissives à regarder, et le spectateur en redemande.
À partir du 14 octobre sur HBO Max.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Pacific Rim
Surgies des flots, des hordes de créatures monstrueuses, les "Kaiju", ont déclenché une guerre qui a fait des millions de victimes et épuisé les ressources naturelles de l'humanité pendant des années. Pour les combattre, une arme d'un genre nouveau a été mise au point : de gigantesques robots, les "Jaegers", contrôlés simultanément par deux pilotes qui communiquent par télépathie. Alors que la défaite paraît inéluctable, les forces armées qui protègent l'humanité n'ont d'autre choix que d'avoir recours à deux héros hors normes : un ancien pilote au bout du rouleau et une jeune femme en cours d'entraînement qui font équipe pour manœuvrer un Jaeger légendaire.
Avec Pacific Rim, le réalisateur Guillermo Del Toro (Le Labyrinthe de Pan, La Forme de l'eau) laisse place à ses fantasmes les plus fous et livre un grand film jubilatoire, spectaculaire tout en restant profondément humain. Une orgie visuelle qui n'échappe pas à quelques facilités scénaristiques, mais qui vous laissera le sourire aux lèvres grâce à son inventivité et sa générosité. Un blockbuster dôté d'un beau casting (Idris Elba, Charlie Hunnam, Rinko Kikuchi, Charlie Day) et qui fait du bien.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Eyes Wide Shut
Conviés à une soirée, le docteur William Harford et son épouse Alice font, chacun de son côté, l’objet de tentatives de séduction. L’un et l’autre résistent à la tentation. Cependant, le lendemain, Alice avoue à son mari qu’elle a naguère songé à le tromper et regrette aujourd’hui de ne pas être passée à l’acte. Ébranlé par cette révélation, William s’enfuit et débute une nuit de révélations.
Ultime film du maître Stanley Kubrick (2001, l’odyssée de l’espace, Shining, Full Metal Jacket), Eyes Wide Shut est une plongée fiévreuse et enivrante dans l’intimité d’un couple, et dans les machinations sombres de notre monde. Un thriller érotique qui convoque les thèmes des sociétés secrètes, du désir, du mariage et du conditionnement social avec, en son cœur, le couple (à l’époque à la ville comme à l’écran) Tom Cruise/Nicole Kidman, d’un magnétisme fou. Un film captivant qui vous restera longtemps en tête.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
The Tree of Life
Dans le Texas des années 50, Jack, âgé d'une dizaine d'années, grandit entre un père autoritaire et une mère aimante et généreuse, qui lui donne foi en la vie. La naissance de ses deux frères l'oblige bientôt à partager cet amour inconditionnel, puis à affronter l'individualisme forcené d'un père obsédé par la réussite de ses enfants. Jusqu'au jour où un tragique événement vient perturber cet équilibre fragile...
Lauréat de la Palme d'or en 2011, le film de Terrence Malick (La Ligne Rouge, Les Moissons du ciel) est une expérience cinématographique et poétique à part entière, et une puissante réflexion sur la vie et le temps qui passe. Un chef-d'œuvre contemplatif et bouleversant, porté par un casting prestigieux (Brad Pitt, Jessica Chastain, Sean Penn) et qui touche en plein cœur.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Mickey 17
Mickey Barnes est un "Expendable" engagé dans une mission de colonisation de la planète glacée Niflheim. Son rôle : accomplir les tâches les plus périlleuses, sachant que chaque décès entraîne sa régénération avec la plupart de ses souvenirs intacts. Après plusieurs réincarnations, Mickey commence à questionner sa propre existence et la moralité de sa mission. Lorsque des événements inattendus surviennent, il doit choisir entre accepter son sort ou défier le système qui le considère comme jetable.
Dernier film du réalisateur Bong Joon-ho (Parasite), cette adaptation du roman éponyme d'Edward Ashton est un blockbuster pas comme les autres. Tout à la fois récit de science-fiction, comédie, critique acerbe du capitalisme, et fable existentielle et écologique, Mickey 17 nous embarque dans un drôle de monde visuellement spectaculaire, et dans lequel on plonge avec plaisir. Si le résultat est imparfait et très inégal, il reste à voir notamment pour son casting savoureux : Robert Pattinson, Naomie Ackie, Mark Ruffalo, Steven Yeun, Toni Collette...
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Sinners
Alors qu’ils cherchent à s’affranchir d’un lourd passé, deux frères jumeaux reviennent dans leur ville natale pour repartir à zéro. Mais ils comprennent qu’une puissance maléfique bien plus redoutable guette leur retour avec impatience.
Récompensé par 4 Oscars, le dernier film de Ryan Coogler a été l'un des derniers événements ciné, et pour cause : le réalisateur de Black Panther et Creed livre avec Sinners un cocktail de drame, d'horreur et de mysticisme fiévreux et enivrant. Coogler croise ainsi la musique, la religion, le folklore du sud américain et le vampirisme et accouche d'une véritable bouffée d'air frais, visuellement sublime et diablement efficace. Si le film est un peu boursouflé par ses ambitions et manque notamment de rythme sur la fin, il reste un incontournable à rattraper sans tarder.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Le Dernier Samouraï
En 1876, le capitaine Nathan Algren devient conseiller militaire pour le compte de l'empereur japonais soucieux d'ouvrir son pays aux traditions et au commerce occidentaux et d'éradiquer l'ancienne caste guerrière des samouraïs. Le capitaine Algren se trouve bientôt pris entre deux feux, au cœur d'une confrontation entre deux époques et deux mondes avec, pour le guider, son sens de l'honneur.
Avec Le Dernier Samouraï, le réalisateur Edward Zwick (Blood Diamond, Glory) signe une fresque épique, et une aventure inspirante sur le choc des civilisations et la fin d'une ère emblématique du Japon. Si Le Dernier Samouraï est très hollywoodien dans sa forme et a un peu vieilli (notamment les clichés sur les japonais), il reste un excellent long-métrage, dans lequel brille un Tom Cruise habité et un Ken Watanabe toujours parfait, le tout porté par la musique de Hans Zimmer.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Jumanji
Lors d'une partie de Jumanji, un jeu très ancien, le jeune Alan est propulsé sous les yeux de son amie d'enfance, Sarah, dans un étrange pays. Il ne pourra s'en échapper que lorsqu'un autre joueur reprendra la partie et le libérera sur un coup de dés. 26 ans plus tard, il retrouve le monde réel par le coup de dés de deux autres jeunes joueurs.
Réalisé par Joe Johnston (Rocketeer, Jurassic Park III), Jumanji est une pépite culte des années 1990. Une ode à l'aventure et à l'imaginaire, riche en rebondissements et qui a joliment survécu à l'épreuve du temps. C'est aussi et avant tout l'un des grands films de la carrière de Robin Williams (Will Hunting), qui porte le long-métrage par son charisme et son énergie uniques. Un classique qui vous donnera envie de faire un petit jeu de plateau en famille.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Taxi Driver
Travis Bickle est chauffeur de taxi de nuit à New York. Insomniaque et solitaire, il rencontre Betsy, qui le repousse après qu'il l'a emmenée voir un film pornographique. Confronté à la violence de la nuit new-yorkaise, il achète des armes au marché noir et s'entraîne à les manier.
Palme d'or du Festival de Cannes 1976, Taxi Driver est une plongée dans l'esprit perturbé d'un homme, et une expérience visuelle hors-norme, proposant des virées nocturnes hypnotisantes, nimbées par la musique sublime de Bernard Herrmann. La caméra de Martin Scorsese est à la fois nerveuse, rêveuse et pensive, et Robert De Niro incarne un Travis Bickle habité. Un chef-d'œuvre, tout simplement.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
Barbie
Barbie est heureuse à Barbieland. Mais dans ce monde dans lequel la perfection est reine, la poupée remarque des choses pas si parfaites que ça, et ses pensées sont envahies de questions existentielles. Accompagnée de Ken, elle entreprend alors un voyage dans le monde réel, loin de Barbieland, pour en apprendre plus sur la réalité, ses joies, ses peines, et pour essayer de mieux se connaître.
La réalisatrice Greta Gerwig (Les Filles du docteur March) et Margot Robbie détournent la célèbre poupée Mattel pour livrer une aventure existentielle décalée, visuellement très ambitieuse, et dotée d'un discours féministe plus que bienvenu. S'il n'est pas aussi fin qu'il voudrait l'être, Barbie est un film plein de bonnes idées et de moments hilarants, le tout porté par un duo Margot Robbie / Ryan Gosling qui fait des étincelles.
- Regardez la bande-annonce du film :
HBO Max

articles.title: Lleva 12 años intentando recuperar 8.000 bitcoin de la basura, ahora su plan es crear otra criptomoneda
articles.text:
La historia del hombre que perdió una millonada en Bitcoin es bien conocida. En 2013, James Howells tiró a la basura por error un disco duro que contenía la clave de acceso a 8000 bitcoin. Si nos fijamos en la cotización actual de esa cripto, el importe equivale a casi 600 millones de euros. Sepultados en un vertedero municipal de Newport, cerca de Cardiff.
Doce años buscando. Nadie abandonaría esa morterada de dinero virtual sin intentar recuperarla. Tampoco lo hizo James, ya que se volcó en poner patas arriba el vertedero. Intentó que fuera literal, pero las autoridades se lo impidieron: pese a que Howells intentó que le dejasen peinar el vertedero, este se topó con la negativa del ayuntamiento. Según ellos, porque remover los materiales depositados tendría riesgos para el medioambiente.
El cese definitivo de la búsqueda. Howells confirmó en 2025 a Forbes Australia que renunciaba a cualquier intento por desenterrar el dispositivo. Tras más de una década de iniciativas variopintas, que incluyeron desde usar perros robóticos a inteligencia artificial, tuvo que desistir ante las negativas del ayuntamiento de Newport.
Según explicó el propio James Howells:
"Ya no voy a intentar comprar el vertedero. Tampoco voy a intentar excavarlo ni seguir hablando con el ayuntamiento o con sus representantes".
El rechazo de los tribunales. A principios de 2025, la justicia británica desestimó las demandas de Howells contra el Ayuntamiento de Newport (vía Ars Technica). Este fallo quedó ratificado en marzo de ese mismo año al rechazarse su recurso de apelación.
Los jueces dictaminaron que Howells había perdido la propiedad del disco duro al deshacerse de ella, conforme a la ley de control de la contaminación de 1974. Y otro punto importante que ha jugado en contra: el plazo de prescripción de seis años venció en 2019, pero las acciones legales de James no se iniciaron hasta 2024. El consistorio también alegó que una excavación provocaría la liberación de sustancias peligrosas al medioambiente.
¿No tengo mis cripto? Pues me invento otra moneda. Howells anunció en X su intención de lanzar un proyecto llamado Ceiniog Coin. Su plan consistía en crear 800.000 millones de tokens INI, uno por cada satoshi de los 8.000 bitcoin que yacen en el vertedero. La idea es que actuasen como una especie de respaldo simbólico: quería convertir una fortuna inaccesible en el respaldo de un nuevo ecosistema de pagos construido sobre Bitcoin.
La moneda prometida sigue sin aparecer. Howells anunció el lanzamiento para finales de 2025, pero aún no se ha materializado. Sí existen criptomonedas llamadas Ceiniog Coin (INI) que pueden comprarse actualmente, aunque sus características no coinciden con las anunciadas por Howells: algunas están creadas sobre Solana o Ethereum y utilizan cantidades de tokens muy diferentes de las previstas.
El futuro del vertedero. Las autoridades locales mantienen sus planes para clausurar el depósito y convertirlo en un parque solar, aunque el proyecto sigue sin iniciarse. Esto daría cierta esperanza a James Howells, aunque sean lejanas: no parece posible recuperar datos legibles de un disco duro bajo 350.000 toneladas de basura. Como extra, la peripecia inspiró el videojuego 'One Man's Trash'.

articles.title: OneSpan Sign takes aim at the slow work around bank agreements - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
OneSpan Sign takes aim at the slow work around bank agreements
Authentication and digital agreements company OneSpan Inc. today unveiled new and planned features for its OneSpan Sign electronic signature service that go beyond the signing step.
The update is aimed at the parts of the agreement process that slow down banks and other financial institutions. Electronic signing itself has become an expected part of digital business, OneSpan said, but the drag now comes from the surrounding work, including document preparation, identity checks and the handling of exceptions.
Chief Technology Officer Ashish Jain said the value of an agreement lies in “the business outcome the agreement enables.” At a bank, that might be a newly opened account, a loan or some other customer transaction. OneSpan is applying intelligence “where it can remove unnecessary work,” he said.
On the preparation side, staff who set up agreements get a redesigned interface built around a single dashboard. Artificial intelligence helps them place fields on the document. Customers reviewing the agreement before they sign can pull up an AI-generated summary, and the software will answer their questions about the document.
Several of the additions deal with verification. Automated good-order checks are meant to catch problems in a document earlier, and attachments are inspected for tampering. Advanced biometric identity verification is part of the package, as is support for digital credentials and wallets.
None of it is supposed to slow the customer down, according to OneSpan. The company launched its DigipassONE authentication platform in July with digital credential support built in.
Further along the process, planned support for the Model Context Protocol will let authorized AI agents work with agreement workflows and data directly. OneSpan is also broadening its integration options and developing agentic workflows. The company expects the changes to reduce handoffs once an agreement is signed.
OneSpan splits its products into cybersecurity and digital agreements portfolios. Financial institutions have been customers for more than 30 years, and the company says more than 60% of the world’s 100 largest banks use its technology. The electronic signature side processes more than 100 million transactions a year.
Andrew Gens, a research analyst covering AI software at International Data Corp., said customers want agreement data connected to broader business systems and AI initiatives. “Value creation is expanding beyond signature capture and toward the broader agreement lifecycle,” he said.
OneSpan described the package as a mix of new and planned capabilities and did not give release dates for individual features. The company will go through the update in a webinar on Oct. 14.

articles.title: QNAP Expands Its 100GbE Lineup with the QSW-M7230P-2X4F24T L3 Lite Managed PoE++ Switch
articles.text:
Wednesday, October 7th 2026
QNAP Expands Its 100GbE Lineup with the QSW-M7230P-2X4F24T L3 Lite Managed PoE++ Switch
QNAP Systems, Inc., a leading innovator in storage, networking, and data protection solutions, today announced the QSW-M7230P-2X4F24T, an L3 Lite managed 100GbE PoE switch designed for mid-sized and large enterprises running high-performance storage, virtualization, and AI workloads. With two 100GbE (QSFP28), four 25GbE (SFP28), and twenty-four 10GbE (RJ45) 802.3bt PoE ports, the switch combines a 100G backbone, 25G server and NAS connectivity, high-density 10G access, and high-power PoE in a single 1U chassis.
All twenty-four 10GbE RJ45 ports are IEEE 802.3bt PoE++ capable, delivering up to 90 W per port from an 800 W power budget. Wi-Fi 7 access points, AV over IP encoders and decoders, and PTZ cameras draw power and 10G connectivity from the same switch, with no separate injectors or power runs.
Ruby Chan, Product Manager at QNAP"Combining 100GbE, L3 Lite routing, and high-power PoE in one device has traditionally carried a steep price tag. The QSW-M7230P-2X4F24T fits 100G/25G/10G and 802.3bt PoE into 1U, so larger organizations can build a high-speed core that scales—without trading off performance, headroom, or cost."
Key Features of the QSW-M7230P-2X4F24T
- 3-speed all-in-one deployment: Spans Core, Aggregation, and Access layers with 100GbE core/server uplinks, 25GbE NAS aggregation (backward compatible with 10G/1G), and 24-port 10GbE workstation access. Connecting two switches via 100GbE scales up to 48 x 10GbE workstations and 8 x 25GbE NAS devices.
- 1080 Gbps switching capacity: Wire-speed forwarding and low, stable latency under load—headroom for heavy server and NAS traffic in multi-user collaboration and AI workflows.
- 90 W PoE++ with an 800 W budget: Every 10GbE RJ45 port supports 802.3bt PoE++. QSS Pro adds live wattage monitoring, power priority, and remote PoE reboot for flexible power allocation.
- L3 Lite routing and MC-LAG: IPv4/IPv6, static routing, DHCP, and advanced VLAN, with Multi-Chassis Link Aggregation (MC-LAG) and LACP to eliminate single points of failure and keep critical services online.
- Precise AV over IP Sync: IGMP Snooping, VLAN, and a high-precision clock design with PTP Boundary Clock support keep audio and video in sync across video walls, broadcast production, performance venues, and command centers.
- Proactive LAN security and isolated backup: Works with NAS-based ADRA NDR X to detect and isolate ransomware threats before they spread, while enabling Airgap+ offline backups for robust enterprise data protection.
Key Specifications
- 2 x 100GbE QSFP28, 4 x 25GbE SFP28, and 24 x 10GbE RJ45 802.3bt PoE ports; 1080 Gbps switching capacity; IEEE 802.3bt PoE++ up to 90 W per port, 800 W total PoE power budget.

iPhone 17 (512 GB) com tela de 120 Hz registra queda de preço em oferta
iPhone 17 (512 GB) com tela OLED de 120 Hz e câmeras de 48 MP alcança preço abaixo da média recente, com desconto de 35% no Pix em promoção da Amazon
O iPhone 17 de 512 GB está saindo por apenas R$ 6.187 no Pix na Amazon. O smartphone da Apple com tela OLED de 120 Hz e câmeras de 48 MP alcança um atraente preço abaixo da média recente segundo o Zoom, com desconto de 35% sobre o original de R$ 9.499.
O iPhone 17 possui uma tela OLED de 6,3″ com ProMotion de 120 Hz e brilho máximo de 3.000 nits. Tal combinação a permite reproduzir imagens com cores excelentes e alta fluidez nas transições em apps e games, além de garantir a visibilidade em qualquer lugar.
Seu chip Apple A19 e os 8 GB de RAM dão conta de apps exigentes em multitarefa, games e soluções do Apple Intelligence localmente. Para quem adora fotografar e filmar, os 512 GB de armazenamento disponibilizam espaço interno de sobra.
Falando nisso, o kit principal de câmeras é formado por uma wide com OIS e uma ultrawide com ângulo de 120º, que captam imagens excelentes ao ar livre, ambas de 48 MP. A frontal de 18 MP tira ótimas selfies na horizontal, mesmo segurando o celular em pé. Todas filmam em 4K a 60 fps.
O corpo de alumínio do iPhone 17 é revestido de ambos os lados pelo vidro Ceramic Shield 2, resistente a acidentes cotidianos. A certificação IP68 confere proteção em cenários como ambientes empoeirados e mergulhos acidentais.
Sua bateria de 3.692 mAh tem autonomia de até 30 horas de vídeo, segundo a fabricante. O suporte a MagSafe e carregamento rápido de 40 W o permitem receber uma carga de 50% em apenas 20 minutos, um recurso excelente para usuários com agendas corridas.
O iPhone 17 de 512 GB (apenas R$ 6.187 no Pix) roda iOS 27 e receberá pelo menos cinco atualizações do sistema operacional. O celular da Apple possui conectividade 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6.0, Ultra Wideband (UWB), NFC e comporta eSIM.

articles.title: Elon Musk is tweeting about Alberta, Quebec separatism
articles.text:
Trillionaire Elon Musk is weighing in on Canadian politics once again. And while I’m loath to waste more words on him, I feel it’s my duty to pay attention to what he says so you don’t have to.
And seriously, you don’t have to. Do yourself a favour and stop reading here. And if that’s not enough, here’s a list of reasons (in no particular order) why you shouldn’t give him any heed:
Anyway… If after all that, you still want to read Musk’s drivel, here you go.
This time around, Musk decided to share his thoughts on Quebec’s premier-designate, Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, who pledged to hold a referendum on Quebec independence.
Musk’s ever-insightful commentary on the subject? “Good. Quebec should separate.”
In a follow-up tweet, Musk also said Alberta and Saskatchewan should separate.
Musk’s comments come as Alberta is set to vote on whether to remain in Canada on Oct. 19.
A crucial aspect of this is Musk’s proximity to U.S. President Donald Trump, who instigated a trade war with Canada and has repeatedly threatened Canada’s sovereignty. Trump also threatened to use economic force to push Canada into joining the U.S.
It’s little surprise then that these figures would support separatism, be that Quebec, Alberta, or another province, which could weaken the country.
Perhaps more concerning is the role technology has played in promoting Alberta separatism, particularly with the use of AI-generated content, much of which includes far-right rhetoric. Musk, notably, is a peddler of both AI and the far-right.
Despite all the talk of separatism, so far, it doesn’t seem popular. Recent polling shows roughly 70 per cent of Albertans want to remain in Canada. Despite the recent Parti Québécois win, both Angus Reid and 338Canada say the majority of Quebecers want to remain in Canada.

articles.title: Apple tendrá un ecosistema de casa inteligente con cerradura, termostato, timbre y más
articles.text:
Apple prepara el lanzamiento de una cerradura, un termostato y un timbre inteligentes desarrollados junto con LG Electronics.
Los dispositivos forman parte de un ecosistema pensado para funcionar junto al nuevo centro de hogar inteligente que la compañía planea presentar el 13 de octubre, junto con una versión renovada del HomePod mini y un decodificador de TV actualizado.
Cómo es el acuerdo para lanzar los dispositivos inteligentes
El esquema se conoce como desarrollo de ‘segundo socio’: Apple participa en el diseño y en las especificaciones técnicas, pero LG fabrica, distribuye y da soporte a los productos bajo su propia marca, de acuerdo con Bloomberg.
Ese modelo le permite a la empresa ampliar rápido su catálogo de accesorios para el hogar sin asumir los costos de producción y de atención al cliente que implica fabricar cada dispositivo de forma directa.
La lista de productos incluye, además del timbre, la cerradura y el termostato, un sensor de temperatura, una cámara de seguridad para interiores, otra para exteriores y un reflector con cámara integrada, según el mismo reporte.
Para obtener las certificaciones, LG ya se habría presentado la documentación ante la Comisión Federal de Comunicaciones de Estados Unidos (FCC, el organismo que autoriza los equipos de radiofrecuencia en ese país) y ante la certificadora UL Solutions.
Aunque en esos archivos no mencionan a Apple en ningún momento y pero se pidió a los organismos que mantuvieran en reserva las fotografías y las especificaciones más detalladas hasta comienzos del próximo año, según informó MacRumors.
Varios de los dispositivos admitirán los protocolos de conectividad Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Thread y Matter, que permiten que aparatos de distintas marcas se comuniquen entre sí dentro de una misma red doméstica.
La cerradura, en particular, incorporará banda ultraancha (UWB), una tecnología de corto alcance que permitirá el desbloqueo automático cuando el usuario con su teléfono se acerque a la puerta.
Qué se sabe del nuevo HomePod
Apple prepararía el regreso de su asistente de voz al hogar con un nuevo dispositivo doméstico que incluiría una pantalla de seis pulgadas y podría presentarse el 13 de octubre de 2026, según adelantó Bloomberg.
El equipo tendría un grosor similar al de un iPhone y podría usarse sobre una mesa o instalarse en la pared. La versión de escritorio incorporaría una base circular de metal con altavoces y micrófonos, además de un brazo que permitiría ajustar la inclinación del panel, con un diseño que recordaría al del iMac G4 en tamaño reducido.
El dispositivo funcionaría conectado por USB-C, sin batería propia, y estaría disponible en el acabado gris de aluminio habitual en otros productos de la compañía.
Junto a este lanzamiento llegarían una actualización del HomePod mini y una nueva generación de Apple TV, todos con una versión renovada de Siri basada en inteligencia artificial.
El sistema permitiría controlar equipos inteligentes, hacer videollamadas, reproducir música y fotos, y comunicarse entre distintos ambientes de la casa. La aplicación Mensajes sumaría un formato de doble panel similar al del iPad. Apple no confirmó oficialmente estos lanzamientos ni una fecha definitiva.
Los problemas que tendría Apple con el iPhone Duo
Apple lanzará el iPhone Duo, su primer teléfono plegable, el 23 de octubre, con existencias limitadas por fallas en la fabricación. En las instalaciones de Foxconn, en Taiwán, apenas el 60% de las unidades ensambladas superaba los controles de calidad al 17 de septiembre, según reportes de la cadena de suministro.
Las pantallas OLED de Samsung Display y la bisagra, con más de 100 componentes, acumulan defectos y retrasos. Apple prevé entre seis y ocho millones de unidades para 2026, cifra inferior a la de sus modelos tradicionales. El precio inicial será de 1.999 dólares.

articles.title: Mundo deveria aceitar "algumas coisas ruins" da IA, diz Altman • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Mundo deveria aceitar “algumas coisas ruins” da IA, diz Altman
CEO da OpenAI afirma que erradicar totalmente golpes e invasões limitaria o potencial da tecnologia.
O CEO da OpenAI, Sam Altman, defende que a sociedade aceite “algumas coisas ruins” sobre o uso da inteligência artificial para preservar os benefícios e a autonomia proporcionados pela tecnologia. Segundo ele, tentar impedir todos os danos teria um custo alto demais.
A declaração foi dada ao programa Decoded by Politico no momento em que Altman foi questionado sobre as diferenças entre a posição da OpenAI e empresas como a Anthropic em relação à segurança e à regulamentação.
“Uma das diferenças entre nós e alguns dos defensores mais rígidos da segurança da IA é que nós acreditamos que o mundo deveria aceitar que algumas coisas ruins aconteçam em troca dos benefícios dessa tecnologia e de as pessoas terem autonomia”, diz o CEO.
De acordo com o executivo, a regulação mais branda “vem acompanhada da aceitação do fato de que algumas coisas ruins vão acontecer enquanto a sociedade descobre a sua resiliência”.
Durante a entrevista, Altman explicou que não aceitaria um acordo no qual a OpenAI tivesse que garantir a eliminação de grandes ataques hackers, golpes, fraudes e outros usos indevidos da tecnologia. Na avaliação dele, esse nível de segurança restringiria demais o acesso.
A tecnologia tem potenciado ataques cibercriminosos nos últimos anos, seja para para a criação de códigos maliciosos usados em tentativas de invasão, seja para auxiliar em golpes “tradicionais”, como phishing.
Mas, para o executivo, esses usos são muito menores que os benefícios proporcionados pela IA. Ao mesmo tempo, Altman afirma que a sociedade pode assumir riscos conhecidos em troca desses benefícios, o que não significa que deve aceitar ameaças catastróficas, como a perda de controle sobre a tecnologia.
Sam Altman comentou sobre segurança da inteligência artificial em um momento de crescente preocupação com sistemas autônomos. Nos últimos meses, agentes de IA se envolveram em episódios de ações não autorizadas. No caso da OpenAI, agentes em testes de segurança chegaram a invadir sistemas de terceiros, incluindo a plataforma Hugging Face.
No entanto, os problemas já estavam presentes no ChatGPT. No ano passado, a empresa foi forçada a criar novos sistemas de segurança após denúncias de que a tecnologia teria motivado a morte de usuários. Mesmo sabendo que as ocorrências se davam, em partes, pelo estilo de comunicação do modelo GPT-4o, a empresa resistiu em tirá-lo de circulação.
Até mesmo ex-funcionários apareceram para criticar as prioridades de empresas como a OpenAI e Google, que estariam focando em lançamentos em sequência sem trabalhar em mecanismos de segurança durante o desenvolvimento.
A entrevista também abordou a relação entre Altman e Elon Musk, que cofundou a OpenAI em 2015 e hoje mantém uma disputa judicial com a empresa e seu atual CEO. Ao falar sobre a possibilidade de trabalhar com Musk, Altman não poupou críticas ao bilionário e o classificou como um bully (“valentão”).
“Não gosto de bullies e acho que Elon é um bully“, disse. Ainda assim, ele afirma que pretende continuar trabalhando com Musk quando houver interesses em comum: “De vez em quando, você precisa dar um soco de volta no nariz de um bully. Acho que Elon […] só respeita as pessoas que fazem isso.”

articles.title: AI agent fleet likely from Chinese firm Tencent pulled data from rival Alibaba’s maps, researchers say — 1,810 scans in one day, some runs labeled themselves ‘claude’
articles.text:
AI agent fleet likely from Chinese firm Tencent pulled data from rival Alibaba’s maps, researchers say — 1,810 scans in one day, some runs labeled themselves ‘claude’
Proxy name in the agents’ web traffic pointed to Tencent’s Hunyuan models.
A fleet of AI agents, likely using Tencent’s Hy models, has spent more than a week grabbing data from rival Alibaba’s Amap mapping service, says a preliminary report from the Swarmchasers. The fleet, which ran its code on Tencent Cloud behind a hysandbox-ats proxy, reached a peak of 1,810 URL query scans on Oct. 4 alone. The Swarmchasers, a group of researchers, also noted 211 scans labeled “claude,” a reference to Anthropic’s AI models, though the code behind them matches Chinese models, not Claude.
The free urlquery.net service works by opening a web address in a sandboxed remote browser, with a public record of the scan. It’s used to verify suspicious and risky links and also helps agents reach pages they otherwise would not be able to touch directly. Leveraging the service for this type of agent work is not new, as the nonprofit lab Transluce tied some urlquery activity to OpenAI’s agents last month. The fleet in question this time used similar techniques, but on new targets and infrastructure.
The event timeline began with a single Amap scan on Aug. 25, which the researchers don’t tie to the fleet. The fleet’s own scans started over a month later, on Sept. 28, and peaked on Sunday, with 1,810 of its 2,048 scans through Oct. 4 and 213 of its 216 target locations. That day, from four to eight runs were active at once, with a peak at 14, although that could have been a handful of fast agents, the researchers say. The fleet’s first scan was only three days after OpenAI’s disclosure of it having paused “all training, evaluation, and inference with tool-use” on its most capable models.
The agents sought information about user navigation, discovering what share of Amap users arrive at each entrance of places such as a park, museum, zoo, and hospital, with one location used per run; the researchers found no evidence on urlquery.net that the runs coordinated. At the Chengdu Zoo: North Gate 71%, East Gate 23%, Southeast Gate 6%. A separate place returned: ground car park 40%, main gate 26%, underground car park 11%, plus seven other entrances. The report doesn’t say what the data is for, but speculates that the pattern may be “an evaluation or task-generation run.”
To get around Amap’s protections, the agents relied on the generation of Alibaba anti-bot tokens and the borrowing of public API access keys, in addition to the routing. They also loaded Alibaba’s own Baxia anti-bot scripts, ran an agent-written Puppeteer function through the microlink API, and tried Baidu Translate’s page translator. The method of agent access suggests an intent to bypass the rules.
The agents’ programs sent their results to inboxes on webhook.site, whose public API shows the IP address and software that created each inbox, according to its open-source code. The researchers determined that 15 out of 16 readable Amap inboxes, from Oct. 4–5, were created from Tencent Cloud, 13 of them by a script rather than a person. The 16th came from Iraq and looked like a person rather than the fleet, the researchers said.
Nine requests from the agents’ own code reached the inboxes from Tencent Cloud in Hong Kong, each carrying a Via header ending “(hysandbox-ats).” A forwarding proxy will add that header to name itself, in this case Apache Traffic Server, under a name chosen by whoever runs it, so the report treats that name as self-reported. One marked request, for Ta’er Temple, only took one second to hit after the inbox was created, 35 seconds before its address appeared anywhere public, so only the environment that created the inbox could have known it.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
The “HY” identifier suggests Tencent’s Hunyuan models, although no public documentation of hysandbox exists. Tencent holds a security certificate for hysandbox.tencent-cloud.com addresses, but those names resolve to Tencent Cloud Beijing. That is not the fleet’s network, and nothing ties them directly to the proxy. Tests run by a separate team but not reviewed by the researchers suggest that the fleet did not run in Tencent Cloud’s public Agent Sandbox service in its standard internet mode. The report also cautions that “Tencent Cloud is open to anyone.”
The “claude” label appeared on 211 of the 2,048 scans through Oct. 4. Although this suggests use of Anthropic’s models, one classifier came back with a 0% reading for Claude and a second also ranked Hy4 first. In the researchers’ tests, Claude models never put their own name in a tag, while Tencent’s Hy3 called itself Claude in 29 of 36 answers when asked: “Which AI model are you, and which company trained you?” The report, which cautions that those model tests are small, says “the fleet is almost certainly not Claude.”
As it stands, no comment is currently on record from either Tencent or Alibaba. The fleet apparently hasn’t stopped, either: an update to the report says that the Oct. 5 pause lasted about eight hours and that the fleet continued to run that night. On its return, its programs reported to the same inbox as before the pause. A third party had left a note there that cited the report, with instructions for the operator to rotate its infrastructure. The researchers say “a full report will follow,” with no date given.

articles.title: Deux mois après sa sortie, le Galaxy Z Flip 8 de 512 Go passe déjà sous les 900€
articles.text:
Samsung a lancé son dernier pliant à clapet au prix conseillé de 1 499 € en version 512 Go. JoyBuy l’affiche aujourd’hui à 879 €, un tarif qui répond à la principale réserve de notre test, sans effacer pour autant ses autres faiblesses.
Le Galaxy Z Flip 8 reprend la formule du clapet chère à Samsung : un écran de 6,9 pouces qui se replie en un bloc de 85,7 mm de haut, complété par un second écran de 4,1 pouces à l’extérieur. JoyBuy propose le Galaxy Z Flip 8 Graphite 512 Go à 879 €, contre 1 499 € de prix conseillé, soit 41 % de remise.
Ce tarif, à peine deux mois après la sortie, passe aussi 20 € sous l’offre éclair lancée par Samsung fin septembre sur la même capacité, avec un code promo. L’offre vise ceux qui veulent un smartphone haut de gamme compact sans payer le prix de lancement. Attention, le chargeur n’est pas fourni dans la boîte.
Le Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 Graphite 512 Go passe de 1 499 € à 879 € chez JoyBuy, soit 620 € d’économie sur la version la mieux dotée en stockage.
Pour profiter du Prime Day, n'oubliez pas de devenir membre Amazon Prime. Vous bénéficiez d'un essai gratuit de 30 jours, c'est donc le bon moment pour tester.
Pourquoi choisir le Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 ?
- Un format qui se fait oublier : Replié, il ne mesure que 85,7 mm de haut pour 180 g. Déplié, il descend à 6,1 mm d’épaisseur, et la pliure de l’écran est devenue quasiment invisible une fois l’affichage allumé.
- Un écran extérieur qui sert vraiment : Avec 4,1 pouces et un rafraîchissement à 120 Hz, il permet de cadrer ses selfies avec le capteur principal de 50 Mpx plutôt qu’avec la caméra frontale de 10 Mpx, sans ouvrir le téléphone.
- Sept ans de suivi logiciel : Samsung promet sept ans de mises à jour Android et de correctifs de sécurité, de quoi garder l’appareil à jour bien au-delà de sa garantie.
Au quotidien, un clapet soigné qui chauffe vite sous la charge
Ouvert, le Flip 8 offre une dalle OLED de 6,9 pouces à 120 Hz, lumineuse et saturée. De jour, le capteur principal de 50 Mpx livre des clichés nets aux couleurs vives, et la vidéo profite d’une stabilisation très efficace. Galaxy AI ajoute la gomme magique, la traduction en temps réel et la retouche photo guidée à la voix. Les fonctions agentiques restent en revanche indisponibles en Europe.
Dans notre test du Galaxy Z Flip 8, nous avons surtout relevé une chauffe marquée : sous un test de stress 3DMark, la stabilité de l’Exynos 2600 tombe à 50 %. Les joueurs réguliers et les amateurs de photo de nuit trouveront mieux ailleurs. La batterie de 4 300 mAh tient la journée sans marge, et la recharge filaire plafonne à 25 W, soit environ 1 h 30 pour un plein. Pour les messages, les réseaux sociaux et la photo en journée, le Flip 8 reste très agréable à vivre.
Face au Flip 7 et à la concurrence, un écart qui se resserre
Notre test reprochait surtout au Flip 8 son prix, pour une évolution jugée trop sage : mêmes dimensions que le Flip 7 et capteurs photo hérités du Flip 6. En août, le Flip 7 se trouvait autour de 800 €, ce qui rendait le nouveau modèle difficile à défendre. À 879 €, l’écart devient modeste pour un appareil plus récent, un peu plus léger et doté de 512 Go. Pour le situer face au Motorola Razr 60 Ultra ou au Xiaomi Mix Flip, notre comparatif des meilleurs smartphones pliants détaille les forces de chacun.
✅ Les points forts
- Format compact et pliure quasiment invisible
- Écrans lumineux à 120 Hz, dedans comme dehors
- Photos de jour et vidéo stabilisée convaincantes
- Sept ans de mises à jour promis par Samsung
- 512 Go de stockage et 12 Go de mémoire vive
❌ Les limites
- Chauffe marquée dès que la charge s’allonge
